title.narrative: UNDP Sustainable Energy Investment Accelerator (SEIA) - Mozambique

description.narrative: SEIA aims to accelerate just and fair energy transition paths in partner countries by strengthening the investment environment for clean energy, easing access to finance and supporting the creation of a pipeline of investment-ready clean energy projects. SEIA value proposition is built on the recognition that financing the sustainable transformation of energy systems is capital-intensive and demands concerted efforts from a wide range of stakeholders to overcome significant barriers through coordinated strategies and interventions. The success of SEIA will depend on strong government commitment, integrated energy strategies, and the creation of enabling environments for investment. SEIA aims to strengthen the investment environment for clean energy, support just energy transitions, enhance governance, increase financing accessibility, improve gender equality outcomes, and drive digital transformation. It integrates social and environmental benefits, leveraging UNDP’s global expertise and fostering partnerships with governments, MDBs, DFIs, donors, and the private sector. SEIA will support renewable energy transitions through system changes, technological innovations, and new business models.
